decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-9fdf3ef2828b], is a one-line changelog entry: "fix(controller): wrong tracking annotation for malformed resources (#22325)". It does not say what the wrong annotation was, which resources count as malformed, or what an operator would see after upgrading, such as a change in sync status, pruning or tracking. Nothing here supports behavior-change at medium severity rather than none or a failure kind. Deciding the consequence needs the PR #22325 description or diff, or upgrade-guide text that describes the before and after effect.
